highlights_headline: The unreleased 4.156.2 changes correct mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads return different glyph data.

bullets.detail: When consecutive font-scaler loads disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded path and avoids incompatible mask copies. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, preventing stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
